# Amsterdam form components

Unmodified label, text-input, and button CSS from
`@amsterdam/design-system-css` version 4.4.0, concatenated into `forms.css`.
Only source-map comments were removed. EUPL-1.2; see LICENSE.txt.

Source: https://github.com/Amsterdam/design-system/tree/main/packages/css
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@amsterdam/design-system-css/-/design-system-css-4.4.0.tgz

The page supplies its own minimal token values in styles.css. The proprietary
Amsterdam Sans font, municipal logo, and token package are not included.
